fee_items.fee_name: Development Impact Fee (DIF) - first two ADUs exempt
fee_items.internal_notes: Verified 2026-11-12: SDMC section 142.0640(b)(1)(A) (Chapter 14, 7-2026 edition, Division 6): the first two ADUs on a premises are exempt from DIF regardless of gross floor area. Exceptions: ADUs built under section 143.1305(c)(1) (two-unit development / urban lot split) pay DIF if over 750 sq ft per (b)(1)(B); a 3rd or later ADU of 750 sq ft or more pays DIF at the multiple dwelling unit rate. A further exemption (b)(1)(C) covers ADUs where the record owner agrees to reside in one of the dwelling units as primary residence for at least 3 years from building permit issuance. The site model is the first ADU on the premises, so $0. Corroborated by the City Public Spaces FAQ (first two ADUs exempt regardless of size; 3rd+ at 750 sq ft or more pays at the multiple dwelling unit rate) and Planning Commission Report PC-25-016 (2025-04-24). Replaces the unsourced FI-004 estimate of $5,000-$8,000, which this section refutes.
fee_items.notes: First two ADUs on a premises are exempt from DIF regardless of size (SDMC section 142.0640(b)(1)(A)). ADUs built under a two-unit development / urban lot split pay DIF above 750 sq ft; a 3rd or later ADU of 750 sq ft or more pays DIF at the multiple dwelling unit rate.
fee_items.source_note: SDMC section 142.0640, Exemptions (1) and (b)(1)(A)-(C) (Chapter 14, 7-2026 edition, Division 6).

fee_items.internal_notes: Verified 2026-11-13: SDUSD levies the SAB Level I residential rate, $5.38/sq ft (Board of Education resolution 2026-03-10; current rates effective May 2026 per the district page header; the district increase notice states May 11, 2026). IB-146 Sec. VIII.D/E: residential construction with an increase in assessable space of 500 sq ft or less is exempt (Ed. Code 17620(a)(1)(C)); an ADU/JADU under 500 sq ft is exempt (Gov. Code 66311.5(c)(3)). 800 sq ft ADU: 800 x $5.38 = $4,304. fee_items.internal_notes: Verified 2026-11-13: IB-501 Sec. III.9 and Table 501D - DSD assesses a Water and Sewer Plan Check Fee when a water and sewer review of any type is performed; 20 fixture units = 1 EDU. SDU/Duplex/Townhome, No Water Meter Change: $176.57 each. Standard case for the model ADU: served through the lot's existing meter (IB-400 requires a Water Meter Data Card, DS-16, for every ADU, so the review is performed). If plan review requires a new meter or upgrade, Table 501D charges $353.13 per EDU instead (not encoded - EDU count depends on the fixture count). Add-ons not in the standard case: new backflow preventer $176.57 each; per floor above 3 levels $87.68.
fee_items.notes: Standard case: ADU served through the lot's existing water meter, so no meter change. If a new or upsized meter is required, Table 501D charges $353.13 per EDU instead.

fee_items.fee_name: County Water Authority capacity charges (shared existing meter - no new meter)

fee_items.internal_notes: Verified 2026-11-13: SDCWA Ordinance 2025-02 Sec. 1(a)-(b) imposes the System Capacity Charge and Water Treatment Capacity Charge only on the establishment of a new metered connection or an increase in capacity of an existing metered connection. Standard case (ADU shares the lot's existing meter, no upsizing): no charge. CY2026 schedule if a new meter is installed (System + Treatment): under 1 inch $6,501 + $182 = $6,683; 1 inch $10,402 + $291 = $10,693; 1.5 inch $19,503 + $546 = $20,049. Upsizing an existing meter is charged on the increase in capacity. CY2027 rates take effect Jan 1, 2027.
fee_items.notes: No CWA capacity charge when the ADU shares the lot's existing meter. A new meter triggers CY2026 charges from $6,683 (under 1 inch).

fee_items.fee_name: Combined plan check + building permit (Tier 3, Residential Category 2)

fee_items.internal_notes: Two-district 50/50 split: AUHSD (grades 7-12) $2.69/sq ft per resolution, Anaheim Elementary SD $2.69/sq ft (AUHSD collects on feeder districts' behalf). Resolution text explicitly states 'inclusive of Accessory Dwelling Units (ADUs)' - series first. No Level 2 history. 800 sq ft = $4,304. fee_items.source_note: AUHSD Resolution 2025/26-F-08 (adopted 2026-05-07)

fee_items.fee_name: Development impact fees - Police/Fire/Library/Parks
fee_items.internal_notes: Adopted-rate total $19,521/unit = Police $1,128 + Fire & Rescue $759 + Library $1,610 + Parks $16,022. ADUs >=750 sq ft pay proportionately (ADU sq ft / primary dwelling sq ft) per Gov. Code 66324/66311.5 rule; ADUs <750 sq ft exempt. City reply 2026-10-07 confirmed park fees apply at 750 sq ft and above. Caveats: 2026-03-24 resolution final adoption date unconfirmed; DTA study's worked example uses max-justified base ($49,522.77, = $15,847.29 for 800/2,500) while adopted base is $19,521 (= $6,247 for 800/2,500 or $10,411 for 800/1,500). SB 1117 (eff. 2027-01-01) requires marginal pro-rata revision.
fee_items.source_note: 2026 DIF Fee Schedule (Proposed); DTA DIF Justification Study 2026-02-12

fee_items.fee_name: OC San sewer capacity charge (CFCC)
fee_items.internal_notes: Corrected 2026-11-13 from per-sq-ft $1.71 ($1,368 at 800 sq ft) to flat $1,710: OC San Table A footnote 1 requires calculations 'on a 1,000 square foot, or portion thereof, basis', so 800 sq ft = one $1,710 block. Same reading as FI-204 (Costa Mesa) and FI-432 (Buena Park). Imposition timing vs. city ordinance burden-proportionate connection charge unconfirmed.
fee_items.notes: SB 1117 (eff. 2027-01-01): no change — connection/capacity charges excluded from SB 1117.
fee_items.source_note: OC San CFCC Tables A/B 2026-27 (eff. 2026-07-01): 'Accessory Dwelling Units will be charged at the average demand rate and the minimum charge does not apply.' Average demand $1,710 per 1,000 sq ft, calculations 'on a 1,000 square foot, or portion thereof, basis' — 800 sq ft ADU = one block = $1,710. City Building Division reply 2026-10-07 confirmed $1.71/sq ft average.

fee_items.fee_name: Building permit (valuation tier Table 1-A)
fee_items.internal_notes: Worked total for 800 sq ft ADU assumes valuation $250,000: $623 + 150 x $4.00 = $1,223 (tier $100,001+). City's actual ADU valuation method unconfirmed (ICC BVD vs. Residential Addition $88/sq ft). Series-lowest permit tier. NPDES 5%, General Plan Update Fee $2/$1,000 valuation, issuance $63, system upgrade $15 are separate add-ons not included here.
fee_items.source_note: Adopted Schedule of Fees & Charges FY 2025-2026, Table 1-A

fee_items.fee_name: Plan review (87% of building permit fee)
fee_items.internal_notes: Official formula: Plan Review = 87% of building permit fee (min $45.02; first 3 submittals included). Worked total assumes permit $1,223.
fee_items.source_note: Adopted Schedule of Fees & Charges FY 2025-2026

fee_items.fee_name: Energy plan check (20% of building permit fee)
fee_items.internal_notes: Official formula: Energy plan check = 20% of building permit fee (per CA Public Resources Code 25402/25402.1). Worked total assumes permit $1,223.

fee_items.fee_name: School district developer fee (FSD + FJUHSD)

Code 17623(a) allocation: FJUHSD (grades 9-12) 33.33% = $1.79/sq ft (justified in official 2026 study) + Fullerton SD (K-8) 66.67% = $3.59/sq ft (arithmetic from $5.38 max; FSD's own 2026 adoption unconfirmed). fee_items.source_note: FJUHSD 2026 Fee Justification Study (2026-04-21); statutory max $5.38

fee_items.fee_name: Park dwelling impact fee (ADU pro-rata)
fee_items.internal_notes: Worked example for 800 sq ft ADU: Park Dwelling Fee $12,020/unit x (800 / 1,500 sq ft primary dwelling) = $6,411. REFERENCE HOUSE SIZE: 1,500 sq ft primary dwelling (brief's assumption). ADU >=750 sq ft pays proportionately to primary dwelling; <750 exempt per Ord. 3343. City's actual pro-rata interpretation (denominator basis) unconfirmed. SB 1117 (eff. 2027-01-01) requires marginal pro-rata revision.

fee_items.fee_name: OC San sewer capacity charge (CFCC)
fee_items.internal_notes: Table A: ADUs charged at average demand rate = $1,710 per 1,000 sq ft or portion thereof; 800 sq ft ADU = $1,710. Fullerton is an OC San board-member city. Whether CFCC is imposed on an ADU (ordinance treats ADU as not a new residential use but allows burden-proportionate charges) is unconfirmed - rate recorded only.
fee_items.source_note: OC San Table A FY 2026-27

fee_items.fee_name: Garden Grove Unified SD developer fee (residential, Level 1)
fee_items.internal_notes: GGUSD is a K-12 unified district with a single residential rate. 2026 state Level 1 max is $5.38/sq ft but GGUSD adoption of $5.38 was not confirmed as of 2026-10-06 (would be $4,304 at 800 sq ft). SB 543: only ADUs at or under 500 sq ft interior livable space are exempt; an 800 sq ft ADU is charged on the full area (cliff, not marginal). $5.17 x 800 sq ft = $4,136.
fee_items.source_note: GGUSD Board Resolution No. 5 (adopted 2024-06-18)

fee_items.fee_name: Combined school developer fee, Level 1 basis (SM-Bonita + SMJUHSD)
fee_items.internal_notes: Conservative verified basis per brief: 2026 state Level 1 statutory max $5.38/sq ft applied through the district split (elementary 71.43%, high school 28.57%); $5.38 x 800 sq ft = $4,304. Both districts justified Level 2 fees by study (elementary $7.02 + high school $2.96 = $9.98/sq ft, i.e. $7,984 at 800 sq ft) but 2026 adoption resolutions were not confirmed as of 2026-10-06, so Level 2 is conditional only and excluded here.
fee_items.source_note: 2026 State Allocation Board Level 1 statutory max; Level I Split Agreement (elementary 71.43% / high school 28.57%)

fee_items.fee_name: Traffic Improvement Fee — Single Family
fee_items.internal_notes: 2026-rule note: Gov. Code §66311.5(c)(1)(B) (pre-SB 1117) charges impact fees on ADUs over 750 sq ft proportionately to the primary dwelling; this row follows the site's per-sq-ft DIF convention (full ADU area x rate), as in Redlands FI-441-FI-450. From 2027-01-01 SB 1117 charges only the area above 750 sq ft. The city's proposed DIF increase (2025 nexus-study draft, about $60,000 per 2,000 sq ft home) is not adopted and is excluded.
fee_items.notes: City Traffic Improvement Fee Program rate for Single Family (also listed for Single Family Additions) is $3.87 per sq ft of gross building area. State law bars impact fees on ADUs of 750 sq ft or less (Gov. Code §66311.5(c)); $3,096 on an 800 sq ft ADU.
fee_items.source_note: City of Santa Maria 2025/2026 Public Works Fee Schedule (July 1, 2025-June 30, 2026), Traffic Improvement Fee Program rates (table Rev. 07/01/2024): Single Family $3.87/sq ft; $3,096 on an 800 sq ft ADU.

fee_items.notes: No fee for ADUs <750 sq ft (codified on DIMF sheets). SB 1117 (eff. 2027-01-01): marginal 50-sq-ft rule — schedule amendment expected.

fee_items.notes: Interpretation: detached ADU classified under R-3 Dwellings. SB 1117 does not change permit fees.

fee_items.source_note: CVUSD Res. 38-25/26 (adopted 3/11/2026, eff. 5/11/2026) and Hayward USD (Jan 2026): $5.38/sq ft residential; <500 sq ft exempt.

fee_items.source_note: Building Division Fee Schedule, eff. 7/1/2026. Table 3-A residential 0.007 x valuation ($193.11/sq ft foothills; $154,488 for 800 sq ft): core $1,544.88 ~ $1,545 (50% plan review + 50% permit + E/P/M). All-in with surcharges ~ $1,812 (Tahoe ~ $2,419).

fee_items.source_note: County formula (Traffic Fee Programs Annual Report, Exhibit B): 'Secondary dwellings >=750 SF = (2nd Dwelling SF / Primary Dwelling SF) x Fee per DUE'. FY25-26 schedule eff. 8/11/2025. Worked example: 800 sq ft ADU, 2,000 sq ft primary, Auburn/Bowman district ($6,833/DUE) = 40% x $6,833 ~ $2,733. District range $1,521-$4,378 (Tahoe to Sunset).
fee_items.notes: Soft 750 cliff (no hard step). SB 1117 (eff. 2027-01-01): for <=2 ADUs, ~$171 on the 50-sq-ft-above-750 basis.

fee_items.fee_name: Deed-restricted ADU (>=750 sq ft): permit fees + traffic (15.28) + parks (15.34) waived
fee_items.source_note: Placer County Code 15.65.110(B): an owner voluntarily deed-restricting an ADU >=750 sq ft for affordability is exempt from building permit fees and the fees in Articles 15.28 (traffic) and 15.34 (parks). Only matrix jurisdiction with a deed-restriction ADU fee exemption.

fee_items.fee_name: City development impact fees (ADU >=750 sq ft, prorated to primary dwelling)
fee_items.source_note: EMMC 17.110.030 + FY25-26 fee schedule (eff. 7/1/2025): SFR DIF base $10,217.26 (sewer $1,652.38 + storm drain $985.03 + street $868.83 + park $6,430.44 + traffic $72.39 + tech 2.08% $208.19; Quimby excluded for ADUs). ADU fee = (800 / primary sq ft) x $10,217.26. Worked examples: $6,812 (1,200 sq ft primary); $4,087 (2,000 sq ft primary). FY26-27 building permit schedule (View/7825, eff. 7/1/2026) checked 2026-11-13 - it contains no DIF table (DIF referred to Public Works/Engineering only); FY25-26 Public Works schedule remains the city's current published DIF source (Permits page lists 'Fee Schedule - FY25-26 Eff July 1, 2025').
fee_items.internal_notes: FY26-27 DIF check 2026-11-13: Building Permit Fee Schedule (elmonteca.gov DocumentCenter View/7825, 17 pp., eff. 7/1/2026) has no DIF amounts - Public Works/Engineering DIF referred to by phone only. FY25-26 Public Works Engineering Fees (View/7398, 3 pp.) re-fetched 2026-11-13 (79,839 bytes, md5 4231bd4e92b9fa4943a23ba3b4413107): SFR components re-summed $1,652.38+$985.03+$868.83+$6,430.44+$72.39=$10,009.07 + 2.08% tech $208.19 = $10,217.26, unchanged. City Permits page still links 'Fee Schedule - FY25-26 Eff July 1, 2025' as current. No FY26-27 Public Works schedule found (web search 2026-11-13).
fee_items.notes: Per-dwelling base $10,217.26 (FY25-26 fee schedule; Quimby $15,052.68 excluded — exclusion unverified, review 12/1). Displayed ADU fee is prorated: (ADU sq ft / primary sq ft) x base. At the 1,600 sq ft default primary, an 800 sq ft ADU pays $5,109. Previously encoded $4,087 was the 800/2,000 example, not the base. SB 1117 (eff. 2027-01-01): for <=2 ADUs, ~$319 on the 50-sq-ft-above-750 basis at the same 1,600 sq ft primary (city implementation method pending; verify at 12/1).

fee_items.fee_name: School district developer fee (residential, El Monte Union HSD area)
fee_items.source_note: City of El Monte Building Permit Fee Schedule FY 2026/2027 (eff. 7/1/2026), Outside Agencies - School Fees: residential $3.36-$3.43 per sq ft, required for projects exceeding 500 sq ft; 'Amount varies per district per justification study.' Fees are paid at El Monte Union HSD (3537 Johnson Ave).
fee_items.internal_notes: Combined elementary + high-school total as published by the city; the $3.36-$3.43 range reflects the two elementary districts serving El Monte parcels (El Monte City SD and Mountain View SD), both paired with El Monte Union HSD. Which end of the range belongs to which elementary district is not stated in the schedule and the districts' own justification studies were not found in public search 2026-11-13, so no area split is encoded - do not assign areas by guess. EMUHSD's own FY2020/21 annual report showed its share at $1.34/sq ft, consistent with a sub-cap combined total. Below the $5.38 SAB Level I cap because the districts' justified amounts are lower. SB 543: no school fee on ADUs under 500 sq ft (feeCalc global rule).
fee_items.notes: 800 sq ft x $3.36-$3.43 = $2,688-$2,744 (combined elementary + high-school total; exact rate depends on the parcel's elementary district - El Monte City or Mountain View - verify at the counter; no school fee on ADUs under 500 sq ft).

fee_items.source_note: City ADU Ordinance Summary (Community Development Dept.): 'ADUs Equal to or Greater than 750 SF - Impact fees collected must be proportional to square footage of existing dwelling unit(s).' FY 2023-2025 Master Fee Schedule (Res. 2006.066, eff. 7/2/2006): SF-unit bundle $4,822.63 (police $413.32 + garage $145.70 + water facilities $1,381.25 + wastewater $347.17 + system $0.42 + parks/rec $2,270.10 + enhancements $35.02 + admin $229.65). Worked example: 800 sq ft ADU, 1,400 sq ft primary = $4,822.63 x 800/1,400 ~ $2,756. Display now prorates at the calculator's primary input (1,600 sq ft default = $2,411).
fee_items.notes: Per-dwelling base $4,822.63 (FY 2023-2025 Master Fee Schedule, 8-component single-family bundle). Displayed ADU fee is prorated: (ADU sq ft / primary sq ft) x base. At the 1,600 sq ft default primary, an 800 sq ft ADU pays $2,411. Previously encoded $2,756 was the 800/1,400 example. Two further single-family rows (Services Facilities $320.67 + Facilities $16.03; potential base $5,159.33) are under review for ADU applicability — 12/1. fee_items.fee_name: Fresno Unified School District developer fee

fee_items.fee_name: Quimby parkland dedication fee
fee_items.source_note: Official council exhibits list the Quimby fee as due at Final Map, so an ADU with no final map pays $0 in the spec scenario.
fee_items.notes: Due at Final Map only, so $0 for an ADU on a typical existing lot; distinct from the proportional Park Facility Impact Fee, which is excluded above. Scope in source: ADU on existing single-family lot.

fee_items.fee_name: Planning fee / Zone Clearance for ADU
fee_items.source_note: City ADU Program states pre-approved and custom ADU plans no longer require a Zone Clearance; $0 planning fee.
fee_items.notes: ADUs are ministerial and applications go directly to Building Permit.

fee_items.fee_name: Building permit + plan check (R3 Single-Family/Duplex/ADU, 800 sq ft)
fee_items.source_note: Master Fee Schedule FY2026-27 R3/ADU row gives $2,984 for an 800-sq-ft ADU by schedule arithmetic.
fee_items.notes: Schedule arithmetic: plan review $908 + 3 x $38 = $1,022 plus permit inspection $1,731 + 3 x $77 = $1,962; 800 sq ft falls in the 500 sq ft bracket with 3 additional 100-sq-ft units. Scope in source: ADU (800 sq ft).

fee_items.fee_name: Planning Building Plan Review (new residential unit / detached ADU)
fee_items.source_note: Master Fee Schedule Section G lists $340 for a detached ADU planning building plan review, in addition to the building permit fee.
fee_items.notes: With a city stock plan the review fee is $58 instead of $340. Scope in source: Detached ADU.

fee_items.fee_name: Permit Processing Fee
fee_items.source_note: Master Fee Schedule confirms a $92 permit processing fee.
fee_items.notes: Excludes percentage add-ons whose base definition is ambiguous (5% General Plan Maintenance, 5% Technology/Records, 11% electrical/mechanical/plumbing each). Scope in source: ADU permit.

fee_items.fee_name: Water/sewer connection (shared existing service)
fee_items.source_note: ADU ordinance states separate utility connections and meters are not required under Gov. Code Section 66324(d)(e), so the typical-case connection cost is $0.
fee_items.notes: Separate utility connections and meters are not required for a compliant ADU; a new meter, if installed, is actual cost with a $750 minimum deposit. Scope in source: ADU on existing serviced lot.

fee_items.fee_name: Quimby Act fee in lieu of dedication
fee_items.source_note: Master Fee Schedule lists the Quimby fee as subdivisions-only, so an infill ADU pays $0.
fee_items.notes: The $3.77/sq ft Quimby rate applies to subdivisions only and is not applicable to an infill ADU on an existing lot. Scope in source: ADU on existing lot (not a subdivision).

fee_items.fee_name: Public Art fee
fee_items.source_note: The public art fee is confirmed not applicable to a residential ADU, so the ADU pays $0.
fee_items.notes: IMC Section 11-140 applies only to new nonresidential private structures (or public buildings) with valuation of $250,000 or more. Scope in source: Residential ADU.

fee_items.fee_name: Park in-lieu fee for ADUs
fee_items.source_note: The official ADU handout states verbatim that the City of Milpitas does not charge a park-in-lieu fee for new ADUs; $0.
fee_items.notes: The citywide park in-lieu rates ($53-$64/sq ft) apply to subdivisions and multi-family projects, but the ADU handout explicitly exempts ADUs. Scope in source: New ADU.

fee_items.fee_name: New address request permit fee
fee_items.source_note: The official ADU handout confirms a $709 new address request permit fee for a new ADU or JADU.
fee_items.notes: A separate address is required for a new ADU or JADU. Scope in source: New ADU/JADU.

fee_items.fee_name: OC San Capital Facilities Capacity Charge for ADUs
fee_items.source_note: OC San Table A (effective July 1, 2026) charges ADUs at the average-demand rate of $1,710 per 1,000 sq ft or portion thereof; an 800 sq ft ADU = one block = $1,710. Minimum charge does not apply to ADUs.
fee_items.notes: ADUs are charged at the average demand rate and the minimum charge does not apply; no 750-sq-ft threshold in the OC San table.

fee_items.fee_name: Developer fee (Savanna ESD, residential)
fee_items.internal_notes: FY2025-26 rate confirmed by the district's Annual Developer Fee Report (FY ending June 30, 2026): $2.585/sq ft residential, same as FY2024-25. No 2026 adoption — all 2026 board meetings Mar-Nov contain no developer-fee item, so the FY2025-26 rate stands as current. AUHSD share for Savanna-area parcels confirmed (FI-549, $2.69): the 2026 Fee Justification Study (Attachment A to Res. 2025/26-F-08) names Savanna School District among the five feeder elementary districts in the Ed. Code 17623(a) allocation agreement, with AUHSD collecting 50% ($2.69). Combined $5.275/sq ft = $4,220 on 800 sq ft. Elementary share alone is $2,068 on 800 sq ft.
fee_items.notes: Savanna ESD parcels only — verify the parcel's district. Pairs with the AUHSD share (FI-549, $2.69); combined $5.275/sq ft = $4,220 on 800 sq ft. ADUs of 500 sq ft or less are $0 school fees statewide from 2026-01-01 (SB 543).
fee_items.source_note: Savanna School District Annual Developer Fee Report, FY ending June 30, 2026: 'The fee amount payable to the District was $2.585 per square foot for residential development' (same rate as the FY2024-25 report); presented to the board 8 Sep 2026 (agenda item 13-g). Fund continuity check: FY2025-26 beginning balance $269,070.14 equals the FY2024-25 ending balance; $59,943.58 received + $7,441.48 interest - $63.08 treasurer fees - $283,971.42 construction = $52,420.70 ending balance, exact.

fee_items.fee_name: Developer fee (Anaheim Union HSD, residential)

Code 17623(a) allocation agreement; same resolution as FI-544/546 (Centralia/Cypress areas). One row per area so the share is never summed into other areas.
fee_items.notes: Savanna ESD / Anaheim Union HSD parcels only -- verify the parcel's district. Pairs with the Savanna ESD share (FI-547, $2.585); combined $5.275/sq ft = $4,220 on 800 sq ft. ADUs of 500 sq ft or less are $0 school fees statewide from 2026-01-01 (SB 543).
fee_items.source_note: AUHSD Resolution No. 2025/26-F-08 (adopted 7 May 2026, 5-0), Sec. 15: $2.69/sq ft residential; 2026 Fee Justification Study (Koppel & Gruber, 13 Apr 2026) -- the study's fee-sharing section names Savanna School District among the five feeder elementary districts under the Ed. Code 17623(a) allocation agreement, with AUHSD collecting 50% of the $5.38 cap; effective 6 Jul 2026.

fee_items.source_note: PUSD December 10, 2025 Fund 25 disclosure confirms $2.97/sq ft residential; 800 sq ft = $2,376.

fee_items.fee_name: City development impact fees (Ordinance No. 1212)
fee_items.source_note: Ordinance No. 1212 (adopted 02/24/2026, effective 04/25/2026) sets residential DIF at $2.30/sq ft; 800 sq ft = $1,840.
fee_items.notes: Breakdown: public safety $0.11 + parks $1.10 + general facilities $0.07 + transportation $0.54 + stormwater $0.48 = $2.30/sq ft; ADUs under 750 sq ft are exempt and the per-sq-ft structure means the proportional formula collapses to rate x ADU sq ft. The legacy park fee (Section 16.24.060) was repealed by Ordinance No. 1212 and parks are now inside the DIF item above, so no separate park $0 item is counted. Scope in source: Residential ADU (single unit).

fee_items.fee_name: School developer fee — Folsom Cordova USD, Level II, SFID 2 (Folsom)
fee_items.source_note: FCUSD official fee page: SFID 2 (representing the City of Folsom) $10.26/sq ft residential, eff. 4/16/2026; 800 sq ft = $8,208. ADUs of 500 sq ft or less of assessable space are excluded.
fee_items.notes: Unified TK-12 district; Level I $5.38 justified in parallel only. Board resolution number not retrieved (12/1 target), but rate and effective date are on the district's official page. Scope in source: detached ADU.

fee_items.fee_name: Building permit — Detached and Attached ADUs (flat fee, plan review and inspection included)
fee_items.source_note: Resolution No. 11481, Exhibit A, Section A Item 18: Detached and Attached ADUs $4,709 per permit, including plan review and inspection. Section A header: effective July 1, 2025.
fee_items.notes: Flat fee does not vary with ADU size or valuation. Subject to annual CPI adjustment; CPI-adjusted late-2026 figure not retrieved (12/1 target). Scope in source: detached ADU.

fee_items.fee_name: Design review — spec ADU (exempted ADU)
fee_items.source_note: No standalone ADU planning fee in Resolution No. 11481; an 800 sq ft ADU at or under 16 ft on a non-Historic District lot is an exempted ADU, so design-review fee is $0.
fee_items.notes: Non-exempt ADU lines ($400 Director-level Item 6(d); $864 Ministerial Item 6(k)) do not apply to the spec ADU. Scope in source: detached ADU.

fee_items.fee_name: Permit Processing Fee
fee_items.source_note: Resolution No. 11481, Building Fees Section E: Permit Processing Fee $79; the Section A header (effective July 1, 2025) confirms additional permit processing fees apply to the flat-fee permit types.
fee_items.notes: Scope in source: detached ADU.

fee_items.fee_name: Water service connection charge — ADU sharing the existing service (Golden State Water Company)
fee_items.source_note: GSWC Rule No. 16 (Advice Letter 1946-W, eff. 8/31/2024): no charge for a service connection except enumerated cases, and no capital-facilities schedule applies to Claremont (about 11,000 connections, above the 2,000-connection threshold); an ADU sharing the existing service therefore pays $0 in connection charges.
fee_items.notes: A separately requested second ADU service is billed at actual cost (estimate-based, no fixed tariff amount), not $0. Sharing the service may reclassify the account to multi-family rates or require a larger meter (monthly service-rate consequences, not a connection fee). Scope in source: detached ADU.

fee_items.fee_name: ADU planning application fee
fee_items.source_note: No ADU, JADU, or SB 9 application line exists in the FY27 Master Schedule (Reso CC 2026-41) or the Planning Division fee sheet (Rev. Jul 2026); ADUs are ministerial, so the ADU planning application fee is $0.
fee_items.notes: Technology User Fee 19% applies to planning applications generally, but with no ADU application fee there is no base to apply it to for the spec ADU. Scope in source: detached ADU.

fee_items.fee_name: Zoning Clearance
fee_items.source_note: Resolution No. 2026-4387, Planning Item 23: Zoning Clearance $210 fixed; an ADU requires approval of a zoning clearance (Moorpark Zoning Code 17.28.020(G)) and there is no standalone ADU planning fee.
fee_items.notes: Subject to the 6% Technology Enhancement Fee (Planning Item 52), a percentage add-on not included here because the schema's percentage method is valuation-based. Scope in source: detached ADU.

fee_items.fee_name: Parkland and Recreation Facility Development Impact Fee for ADUs (single-family detached)
fee_items.source_note: Ordinance No. 2065 / Resolution No. 15578 (June 15, 2026), Exhibit B2: ADU park DIF $1.25/sq ft at the current 50% phase; 800 sq ft = $1,000. ADUs under 750 sq ft are exempt per Gov. Code 66324(c)(1).
fee_items.notes: Phased schedule: $1.88/sq ft on 7/1/2027, $2.50/sq ft on 7/1/2028, plus ENR CCI adjustments from 7/1/2027. First phase effective 60 days after adoption (mid-August 2026, exact date not pinned). Whether the counter adds a 66324 proportionality-to-primary overlay to this standalone per-sq-ft ADU rate is not stated (12/1 target). Scope in source: detached ADU.

fee_items.fee_name: Water capacity charge — qualifying newly constructed detached ADU (Marin Municipal Water District)
fee_items.source_note: Marin Water Ordinance No. 469, section 11.56.040(h)(3): no new or separate water service and no capacity charge for one qualifying detached ADU per lot, so the capacity charge is $0 when the conditions are met.
fee_items.notes: Conditions: ADU no more than 1,200 sq ft, lot with an existing primary dwelling already served, owner occupancy of either unit, district water-efficiency standards, and continuous District customer at the parcel for at least one year. Non-qualifying ADUs pay DFU-proportioned charges (meter-size schedule not retrieved).

fee_items.fee_name: Construction Vehicle Impact Fee
fee_items.source_note: Formerly 1% of assessed valuation on all building permits (Reso 11473, 2004); repealed by Resolution No. 15568, adopted June 15, 2026, so the line is $0.
fee_items.notes: Repeal's precise effective date and application to permits already in process were not pinned down (12/1 target). Scope in source: detached ADU.

fee_items.fee_name: Accessory Dwelling Unit planning fee (Planning Division Line 18, with surcharges)
fee_items.source_note: FY 2026-27 Master Fee Schedule, Planning Division Line 18: Accessory Dwelling Unit $866 base + 5% General Plan Update ($43) + 4% Technology ($34) + 3% Permit Streamlining ($25) = $968 total.
fee_items.notes: Standalone ADU planning fee; Ordinance No. 1890 section 16.303.05(A) ties ADU applications to the Master Fee Schedule review fees. Scope in source: detached ADU.

fee_items.fee_name: Sanitary sewer capacity charge — detached ADU, 800-899 sq ft, Mainland (Vallejo Flood & Wastewater District)
fee_items.source_note: VFWD Schedule of Rates eff. 7/1/2026, District Code 4.04.070: ADU capacity bands; 800-899 sq ft Mainland = $2,865. Bands start at 501 sq ft; contained ADUs are never charged.
fee_items.notes: Mare Island schedule differs (800-899 sq ft $3,325); Sears Point supplemental $615/EDU is parcel-specific and not included. The district Developers page wording (post-hoc ADUs pay admin fees only vs. concurrent ADUs pay admin + capacity) sits in tension with the codified band — flagged for 12/1. Scope in source: detached ADU.

fee_items.fee_name: VFWD plan review — Minor Residential 1-2 units (includes ADU new construction)
fee_items.source_note: VFWD Schedule of Rates eff. 7/1/2026, Development Services Administrative Fees: Plan Review, Minor Residential 1-2 Units (expressly includes ADU new construction; up to 3 submittals) $580 per permit.
fee_items.notes: Scope in source: detached ADU.

fee_items.fee_name: VFWD sewer inspection
fee_items.source_note: VFWD Schedule of Rates eff. 7/1/2026, Development Services Administrative Fees: Inspection $400 per permit.
fee_items.notes: Scope in source: detached ADU.

fee_items.fee_name: VFWD permit processing
fee_items.source_note: VFWD Schedule of Rates eff. 7/1/2026, Development Services Administrative Fees: Permit Processing $61.94 per permit/per unit.
fee_items.notes: Admin subtotal with plan review and inspection: $1,041.94. Scope in source: detached ADU.

fee_items.fee_name: School district developer fee (Covina-Valley USD; most of city)
fee_items.source_note: CVUSD Developer Fee Form: $5.38/sq ft residential (SAB 2026 maximum, Res. 25-26-13 eff. 5/11/2026); 800 sq ft = $4,304. CVUSD covers most of Covina; eastern/Charter Oak USD parcels differ and that district's rate was not found — verify per parcel (12/1 target).

fee_items.fee_name: Administrative Design Review — Minor: New Single Family Residence, ADU/JADU
fee_items.source_note: FY2026-27 Community Development Master Fee Schedule (eff. 7/1/2026): ADR-Minor 'New Single Family Residence, ADU/JADU' $1,970 per application — the named planning line for the spec scenario. Whether it is collected on every detached ADU vs. only where design review is triggered was not stated — 12/1 target.

fee_items.fee_name: Permit Issuance (Building)
fee_items.source_note: FY2026-27 Exhibit A Building Permit Fees: Permit Issuance $63.00 each.

fee_items.fee_name: Technology/Training Surcharge
fee_items.source_note: FY2026-27 Exhibit A: Technology/Training Surcharge 0.0025 of valuation (0.25%).

fee_items.fee_name: Building Standards Commission fee (SB 1473)
fee_items.source_note: SB 1473 Green Building Standards fee: $1 per each $25,000 of valuation or fraction thereof, minimum $1.

fee_items.fee_name: State Strong Motion Instrumentation Program fee (SMIP, residential)
fee_items.source_note: CA SMIP: 0.013% of valuation for residential up to 3 stories.

fee_items.fee_name: School district developer fee (Salinas-area pockets: SUHSD Level II, shared)
fee_items.source_note: SUHSD Resolution No. 26-92 (adopted 6/9/2026): Level II $4.82/sq ft residential, shared by feeder districts and the high school district; 800 sq ft = $3,856. Covers Salinas-area unincorporated pockets only — North County (NMCUSD) and other areas differ; see research file (12/1 targets).
fee_items.notes: Salinas-area pockets only; not a countywide rate.

fee_items.fee_name: County development impact / park / construction tax (none adopted)
fee_items.source_note: OC Public Works Development Services fee schedule (Res. 24-058, eff. 7/21/2024) searched in full: zero impact-fee, Quimby, or construction-tax entries; county ADU path is ministerial (Zoning Code Sec. 7-9-90). County DIF/park/construction tax = $0 for the spec ADU. TCA corridor DIF (south-county benefit area) is separate and PARTIAL.

fee_items.fee_name: Contractor's Business Tax Registration (per project)
fee_items.source_note: City FAQ: general contractors pay 0.2125% of project valuation per project at permit issuance (subcontractors under the GC covered). Levied on the contractor, but a real valuation-scaled cost of every Beverly Hills permit.
fee_items.notes: Levied on the general contractor, not the owner directly.

fee_items.fee_name: Town development impact / park / Quimby / parking fees (no program)
fee_items.source_note: Housing Element: 'The Town does not have any park, open space, parking or other similar development or impact fees.' FY26-27 Master Fee Schedule read in full: no development impact fee line at all (Park Fees section is Holbrook-Palmer Park rental rates).
fee_items.notes: Town DIF is $0 on both sides of the 750 sq ft line; the state-law <750 rule has nothing to attach to. SB 1117 changes nothing here (no covered town fee).

fee_items.fee_name: ADU planning fee (setback fork)
fee_items.source_note: FY26-27 Master Fee Schedule: Item 94, ADU complying with Town Setbacks Standards, $0; Item 95, other ADU, $1,860. Range, not a sum: one branch applies per parcel.
fee_items.notes: Planning Technology Surcharge 3.80% ($70.68 on $1,860) is conditional and not included.

fee_items.fee_name: Water connection - ADU sharing the existing service (Cal Water Bear Gulch)
fee_items.source_note: Town ADU ordinance text (Ch. 17.52): a new ADU with an existing main residence shall not be required to have separate utility connections. Cal Water Bear Gulch tariff territory includes Atherton (CPUC).
fee_items.notes: Shared-service baseline only. A current published separate-service/meter charge was NOT FOUND (2024 Housing Element $20,000-$40,000 range not carried) - 12/1 target.

fee_items.fee_name: ADU planning fee
fee_items.source_note: FY2027 Master Fee Schedule, Planning item 7.26: ADU $851 flat (FY2026 $827; FY2025 $811).
fee_items.notes: Ministerial ADU; no Use Permit, Design Review-Major, or other discretionary planning fee applies.

fee_items.fee_name: Address assignment (legal secondary unit)
fee_items.source_note: FY2027 Master Fee Schedule, item 3.47: Processing Address Assignment for Commercial Properties and Legal Secondary Units, $281 flat. A new detached ADU requires a separate address.

fee_items.fee_name: Inclusionary housing in-lieu fee (single ADU)
fee_items.source_note: Inclusionary Housing Ordinance No. 1423 (Municipal Code Ch. 17.47, operative 7/1/2018): 'Residential Development' means a project creating five or more dwelling units; in-lieu thresholds 15 for-sale / 20 rental. A single detached ADU is below the chapter's applicability threshold.
fee_items.notes: Ordinance under active amendment (Sept 2026 council introduction of a local-preference amendment) - re-check at 12/1.

fee_items.fee_name: Zoning Clearance
fee_items.source_note: Schedule of Fees and Charges FY2026-27, Development Services: Zoning Clearance $215. ADUs are by-right; 45-day action on complete applications.
fee_items.notes: ADUs exempt from Design Review. No standalone ADU planning fee exists.

fee_items.fee_name: Development Services Plan Check
fee_items.source_note: Schedule of Fees and Charges FY2026-27, Development Services: Plan Check $94.

fee_items.fee_name: Building permit issuance
fee_items.source_note: Schedule of Fees and Charges FY2026-27, Building: issuance $85.30.
fee_items.notes: Only the issuance line is encoded. The valuation-based permit total itself is PARTIAL: the current plan-check percentage is not printed ('see attached'; 65% is the 2014-15 historical figure) - 12/1 target.

fee_items.fee_name: Building permit issuance
fee_items.source_note: FY 2027 Master Fee Schedule (adopted 4/21/2026, eff. 7/1/2026), Building: issuance $66.
fee_items.notes: Only the issuance line is encoded. The VA/VB new-construction table structure is confirmed but the R-3 row was not retrieved, so no permit total is stated - 12/1 target.

fee_items.fee_name: Water Availability Review (Sweetwater Authority)
fee_items.source_note: Sweetwater Authority Rates and Rules (eff. 1/1/2026), Sec. 2.9.2: Water Availability Review Flat Administrative Fee $700, payable at application submittal. The rule states expressly: 'This fee is an administrative cost-recovery fee and is not a capacity fee, connection fee, or impact fee.'
fee_items.notes: Authority capacity-fee dollars (Supplement to the Rates and Rules) and the incremental SDCWA Capacity Charge by meter size were NOT retrieved; upsize outcome is fixture-dependent - 12/1 target.

fee_items.fee_name: City Development Impact Fee (DIF[2]) — ADU (proportional)
fee_items.source_note: Adopted DIF schedule (effective 7/1/2023) ADU row: DIF[2] 'Based on Square footage' (Subdivision and In-Fill); amount depends on primary dwelling size. Gov. Code §66311.5 proportional rule for ADUs over 750 sq ft.
fee_items.internal_notes: Added 2026-11-08 (cycle263, 12/1 target #4): resolves the TUMF conflict — the schedule's ADU-row Exempt is TUMF (see FI-345), not City DIF. DIF[2] is the city's own DIF and is proportional, not $0. Amount needs primary-dwelling size; do not total.
fee_items.notes: Scope in source: ADU 750 sq ft or larger; $0 below 750 sq ft per Gov. Code §66311.5.

fee_items.fee_name: Val Verde USD Level I school developer fee (residential)
fee_items.source_note: VVUSD official School Fees page: Level I residential $5.38/sq ft effective July 13, 2026; additions under 500 sq ft exempt. Corroborated by the district's April 27, 2026 School Fee Justification Study (Section VII Table 24, $5.38 justified maximum) and the public-notice hearing scheduled May 12, 2026 to consider and adopt the study.
fee_items.internal_notes: Verified on the district's own current School Fees page (rate + effective date), the same evidence class as FI-344 (MVUSD). Adoption resolution number, adoption date and vote remain unlocated as of 2026-11-08: the district board portal Simbli blocks agent IPs (Imperva Error 16) and historical BoardDocs returns CloudFront 403; do not infer an adoption date from the July 13, 2026 effective date (62 days after the May 12 hearing). ADU 500+ threshold mirrors FI-344 per Gov. Code 66311.5.
fee_items.notes: Applies only to parcels in the Val Verde USD portion of Moreno Valley (southwest slices) — verify the parcel's district before budgeting. $5.38/sq ft effective July 13, 2026.

fee_items.fee_name: Sewer Major Facilities — Single Family Residential
fee_items.internal_notes: HELD at to_verify pending Grok review + ADU application unconfirmed: schedule prices new dwelling units per unit; city ADU Informational Handout (8-16-23) states the rule verbatim - 'No impact fee on an ADU/JADU less than 750 sq. ft. Greater than 750 sq. ft. shall be charged proportionately in relation to the primary dwelling unit' - but no worked example located (checked 2026-11-08). State framework (Gov. Code §66311.5: <750 sq ft $0, >=750 proportional to primary) governs ADU application. Do not total into ADU figures until Grok confirms. Rule found 2026-11-08 (cycle275): CMC §9.40.020(D)(4)(d) — 'Adequate provisions shall be made for the water and sewer service and drainage generated by the occupancy of the accessory dwelling unit as determined by the City Engineer. The ADU/JADU can either have shared or separate services for electric, gas, sewer, and water.' §9.40.020(F)(1) — ADUs are subject to connection fees/capacity charges 'except as provided in' state ADU law (Gov. Code §66314(d), formerly §65852.2(f)): no new/separate connection or fee for conversion/JADU ADUs; a separate connection for other ADUs may carry a proportionate fee. Text per OA 2023-001 packet (Planning Commission 2023-05-25); Council approved the cleanup 5-0 on 2023-06-19; ordinance number unverified; no later ADU amendment found. Shared-service ADU = no new sewer connection charge; separate/new lateral = MDFS 2024-2025 sewer house branch connection 4in $137.00/LF applies, but no ADU-specific amount is published and the per-unit major-facilities rate prices new dwelling units — no ADU amount encoded.
fee_items.notes: Single Family Residential per-unit rate. Multi-family $7,825/unit is a separate line, not encoded.

fee_items.notes: All Residential per-unit rate. Displayed ADU fee is prorated: (ADU sq ft ÷ primary sq ft) × $6,147; at the 1,600 sq ft default primary, an 800 sq ft ADU pays $3,073.50. The AB 602 nexus basis charges the fee per dwelling unit across the sphere of influence (average population per dwelling unit; a per-unit fee is more empirical than a square-footage basis). Non-residential per-sq-ft rates are separate lines, not encoded.

fee_items.fee_name: Sewer General Capacity Fee (per EDU)
fee_items.internal_notes: Verified 2026-11-14: EDU basis resolved from published sources. CMC Table 13.10.020(c)(4) (Ord. CS-207, 2013-03-26) assigns 1.00 EDU to a housing accommodation designed for occupancy by a single person or one family; an ADU meets that definition (Gov. Code §65852.2(j)(1): complete independent living facilities for one or more persons), so 1 EDU x $1,294. Rate $1,294/EDU from MFS FY 2026-27 §3 (eff. 2026-09-01), confirmed against the indexed copy (2026-09-04 crawl); direct fetch of the MFS source URL is 403-blocked (Akamai). Statutory frame: Gov. Code §65852.2(f)(5) allows a proportionate capacity charge for a new detached ADU; (f)(2) says an ADU is not a new residential use for calculating such charges unless built with a new single-family dwelling; (f)(4) bars a new-connection charge for (e)(1)(A) conversion ADUs. The 1.00 EDU figure is the city's published table value, not a size-prorated figure. Caveat: parcels in the Leucadia Wastewater District service area are served by a different agency (LWWD capacity fee $6,240/EDU, eff. 2026-07-01) — follow-up, not encoded. Supersedes the 'pending Grok review' hold (Grok excluded from review since 2026-11-07).
fee_items.notes: One ADU = 1.00 EDU under CMC Table 13.10.020(c)(4) (a housing accommodation for one person or one family), so $1,294 for a new detached ADU. State law allows a proportionate capacity charge for a new detached ADU (Gov. Code §65852.2(f)(5)); no new-connection charge applies to an ADU within existing space (§65852.2(f)(4)). Sewer benefit-area fees are parcel-specific (Areas C $3,327, D $3,334, E $4,918, F $4,944, H $1,451, N $4,761 per EDU; others $0) and are not encoded as separate lines.
fee_items.source_note: Master Fee Schedule FY 2026-27 (eff. Sept 1, 2026), Section 3 — Sewer Fees: General Capacity Fee of $1,294 per EDU for All Areas Plus Sewer Benefit Fees.

fee_items.fee_name: Potable Water Connection Fee — 5/8 in meter
fee_items.internal_notes: VERIFIED 2026-11-14 (cycle427): ADU applicability resolved — no new water connection/capacity charge on a standard detached ADU sharing the lot's existing service. Evidence: (1) IB-111 Accessory Dwelling Units (Aug 2026): 'Having a separate water, sewer or power connection from the existing primary residence is not required'; 'Adequate water and sewer services shall be readily available; Upgrades to existing services may not be required.' (2) City admin decision letter PRE 2025-0004 (4407 Park Dr, Apr 4, 2025): 'Separate water and sewer service for proposed ADU is not consistent with standards. Only one water and sewer service allowed for existing lot.' (3) PRE 2022-0061 (Matthew Duplex, Jan 3, 2022): units 'serviced by a single water service with a sub meter'; verify capacity in the existing meter (CMWD Standard W-5). (4) City Fee Guide REV. 12/23, Example 3 (800 SF detached ADU worksheet, total $8,220.58) lists no water connection or capacity lines. (5) CMWD Rules & Regulations Ch. 2.12 (Ord. 51, Oct 7, 2025): connection fee is paid per new service connection/new meter permit; a credit applies for the existing meter on exchange to a larger size; a 1 in meter required only for fire standby is billed at water-use size (Ord. 45). (6) IB-111: 'A new utility connection may be required' only where existing service is inadequate, with fees based on ADU sq ft or drainage fixture units — conditional and proportionate, not the flat new-connection rate; Gov. Code §65852.2(f)(4) bars a new-connection charge for conversion ADUs. Unlike the sewer General Capacity Fee (NEW-02, $1,294/EDU — charged per dwelling unit), the water fees are charged per new meter/service connection, which a standard ADU does not trigger. Rate stored as $0 ADU-effective (FI-439/FI-332/FI-271 precedent); $5,865 kept in notes as the non-ADU reference amount. MFS FY 2026-27 #594 rate re-confirmed via indexed copy crawled 2026-09-04 (direct fetch Akamai 403, same as cycles 353-367). Supersedes memo branch muse/20261112-0517-carlsbad-new06-memo — discard/rebase it after this branch, or it reverts these notes.
fee_items.notes: Not charged on a standard detached ADU. The $5,865 figure is the new-service Potable Water Connection Fee for a 5/8 in meter (MFS FY 2026-27 #594), charged per new water meter/service connection. A detached ADU on an existing lot shares the lot's single water service — 'Only one water and sewer service allowed for existing lot' (city PRE 2025-0004, Apr 4, 2025) and 'Having a separate water, sewer or power connection from the existing primary residence is not required' (IB-111, Aug 2026) — so no new connection fee applies. If the existing meter is undersized, an upgrade may be required and the charge is only the incremental difference (CMWD Rules Ch. 2.12 credits the existing meter on exchange). Meter-size alternatives: 5/8 in is the low endpoint, 1 in (NEW-07) the high endpoint; do not sum the two.
fee_items.source_note: Master Fee Schedule FY 2026-27 (eff. Sept 1, 2026), Section 1 — Utility Potable and Recycled Water Connection Fees: 5/8 in $5,865 (non-ADU reference amount; no new connection for a standard ADU sharing the existing service — IB-111, Aug 2026; PRE 2025-0004).

Evidence: (1) IB-111 Accessory Dwelling Units (Aug 2026): 'Having a separate water, sewer or power connection from the existing primary residence is not required'; 'Adequate water and sewer services shall be readily available; Upgrades to existing services may not be required.' (2) City admin decision letter PRE 2025-0004 (4407 Park Dr, Apr 4, 2025): 'Separate water and sewer service for proposed ADU is not consistent with standards. Only one water and sewer service allowed for existing lot.' (3) PRE 2022-0061 (Matthew Duplex, Jan 3, 2022): units 'serviced by a single water service with a sub meter'; verify capacity in the existing meter (CMWD Standard W-5). (4) City Fee Guide REV. 12/23, Example 3 (800 SF detached ADU worksheet, total $8,220.58) lists no water connection or capacity lines. (5) CMWD Rules & Regulations Ch. 2.12 (Ord. 51, Oct 7, 2025): connection fee is paid per new service connection/new meter permit; a credit applies for the existing meter on exchange to a larger size; a 1 in meter required only for fire standby is billed at water-use size (Ord. 45). (6) IB-111: 'A new utility connection may be required' only where existing service is inadequate, with fees based on ADU sq ft or drainage fixture units — conditional and proportionate, not the flat new-connection rate; Gov. Code §65852.2(f)(4) bars a new-connection charge for conversion ADUs. Unlike the sewer General Capacity Fee (NEW-02, $1,294/EDU — charged per dwelling unit), the water fees are charged per new meter/service connection, which a standard ADU does not trigger. Rate stored as $0 ADU-effective (FI-439/FI-332/FI-271 precedent); $291 kept in notes as the non-ADU reference amount. MFS FY 2026-27 #626 rate re-confirmed via indexed copy crawled 2026-09-04 (direct fetch Akamai 403, same as cycles 353-367). Supersedes memo branch muse/20261112-1017-carlsbad-new11-memo — discard/rebase it after this branch, or it reverts these notes.
fee_items.notes: Not charged on a standard detached ADU. The $291 figure is the Water Treatment Capacity Charge for a new 1 in meter (MFS FY 2026-27 #626; SDCWA rates eff. Jan 1, 2026), charged per new meter in addition to the potable connection and SDCWA capacity charges. A detached ADU shares the lot's single water service (PRE 2025-0004; IB-111), so no new capacity charge applies. Per CMWD Ord. 45, where a 1 in meter is required only by a fire-sprinkler requirement, capacity charges are based on the meter size needed for water use, not the actual 1 in size. Meter-size alternatives: 1 in is the high endpoint, 5/8 in (NEW-10) the low endpoint; do not sum the two.
fee_items.source_note: Master Fee Schedule FY 2026-27 (eff. Sept 1, 2026), Section 1 — Water Treatment Capacity Charge: 1 in Displacement $291 (non-ADU reference amount; no new connection for a standard ADU sharing the existing service — IB-111, Aug 2026; PRE 2025-0004).

fee_items.fee_name: Certificate of Occupancy
fee_items.internal_notes: VERIFIED 2026-11-14 (cycle430): ADU applicability resolved — the $89 is the fee for a standalone Certificate of Occupancy Permit, not a line charged on a standard detached ADU building permit. Evidence: (1) MFS FY 2026-27 item 1012, 'Certificate of Occupancy, per permit $89', sits in 'Building Department Fees — Minor/Miscellaneous Residential & Commercial Improvements' among standalone flat-fee minor permits (storage tank, awning, bollards, decks, demolition, EV charging, fence, fireplace, remodel, reroofing, solar, pool, SWPPP inspection, waste management plan); the valuation-based new-construction building section carries no CofO line, and a whole-document search returns exactly 2 'Certificate of Occupancy' matches — item 1012 ($89) and Temporary Certificate of Occupancy ($206, a separate line, not this row). (2) City Fee Guide REV. 12/23, Example 3 (800 SF detached ADU, total $8,220.58): a single Building permit fee of $1,330 and no CofO line; the listed lines sum exactly to $8,220.58 without it (864.50+104+197+1,330+1,375.78+44.02+6.28+3,832+467). Example 1 (new detached single-family home, total $76,674.01) likewise lists no CofO line although a new home unquestionably receives a CofO — so the $89 cannot be a standard add-on to every new-construction building permit. (3) The city issues a 'Certificate of Occupancy Permit' for a change of use under CMC 21.60.010: PRE 2025-0032 (2045 Corte de Nogal pickleball conversion, July 21, 2025) — 'Prior to occupancy, a Certificate of Occupancy Permit for a change of use shall be issued per Carlsbad Municipal Code Section 21.60.010'; the same condition appears in Planning Commission Resolutions 7014 (Oct 2, 2013) and 7100 (May 20, 2015), all for change-of-use of an existing building. (4) IB-111 (Aug 2026) mentions no CofO fee or CofO Permit step for ADUs. Residual limitation: no city document states in one sentence that no separate CofO fee applies to new construction; the Fee Guide disclaimer says examples 'do not include all of the fees you can expect', but it names the excluded categories (Special District, Planning, Engineering fees calculated during review; grading/stormwater) and CofO is a Building Division fee inside the guide's stated scope, while lines as small as $6.28 (green building) are included. Boundary not separately confirmed: a conversion ADU changes occupancy classification (U to R-3); whether the city ever requires a standalone CofO Permit for a conversion is not established by the documents above — the $0 encoding covers the standard detached ADU only. Rate stored as $0 ADU-effective (FI-439/FI-332/FI-271 precedent); $89 kept in notes as the standalone-permit reference amount. MFS FY 2026-27 rate re-confirmed via indexed copy crawled 2026-09-04 (direct fetch Akamai 403, same as cycles 353-367). Supersedes memo branch muse/20261112-1217-carlsbad-new12-memo — discard/rebase it after this branch, or it reverts these notes.
fee_items.notes: Not charged as a separate line on a standard detached ADU building permit. The $89 figure is the fee for a standalone Certificate of Occupancy Permit (MFS FY 2026-27 #1012, per permit), issued for a change of use/occupancy under CMC 21.60.010 — e.g. 'Prior to occupancy, a Certificate of Occupancy Permit for a change of use shall be issued per Carlsbad Municipal Code Section 21.60.010' (city PRE 2025-0032, July 21, 2025; same condition in Planning Commission Resolutions 7014 and 7100). A new detached ADU's certificate of occupancy is issued at final inspection under its own building permit, with no separate CofO line: the city's Fee Guide REV. 12/23 Example 3 (800 SF detached ADU, total $8,220.58) lists a single Building permit fee of $1,330 and no CofO line — the listed lines sum exactly to $8,220.58 — and Example 1 (new detached single-family home) likewise lists no CofO line although a new home unquestionably receives a CofO. The MFS lists 'Certificate of Occupancy' only once, as item 1012 among the standalone flat-fee Minor/Miscellaneous permits, and the new-construction building section carries no CofO line. The $89 is kept here as the standalone-permit reference amount.
fee_items.source_note: Master Fee Schedule FY 2026-27 (eff. Sept 1, 2026), Section 2 — Building Department Fees, Minor/Miscellaneous: item 1012 Certificate of Occupancy, per permit $89 (standalone-permit reference amount; no separate CofO line on a standard ADU building permit — Fee Guide REV. 12/23 Example 3; CMC 21.60.010 change-of-use permit, PRE 2025-0032).

Formula per Res. 2021-0195 (BOS agenda 5/11/2021, PH04.pdf): ADU fee = (ADU sq ft / primary sq ft) x single-family fee, lesser of the proportional amount or the ADU flat rate; ADUs up to 750 sq ft exempt. County ADU handout lists the same $3,061 ADU line and the 750 sq ft exemption.
fee_items.internal_notes: Re-encoded 2026-11-09 from the 11-06 draft's flat $3,061: the county's own formula (Res. 2021-0195, PH04.pdf) prorates the $10,171 single-family base by ADU/primary size, with the $3,061 ADU flat rate as the cap ('when the proportional calculated fee is higher than the current ADU flat rate, the lesser fee will be charged'). At the site's 1,600 sq ft default primary, an 800 sq ft ADU prorates to $5,086, so the cap binds and the fee is $3,061 - flat and dwelling-base encodings agree at the default. For a larger primary the fee is lower (e.g. 3,600 sq ft primary: $2,260). SB 1117 (2027-01-01): convertible, (50/1,600) x $10,171 = $318 at the default primary. min_sqft 750 follows the Westminster/Ontario dwelling-base precedent (at exactly 750 the state-law exemption zeroes the line). Park fees are sub-items inside the PFF bundle - no separate park line.
fee_items.notes: Single-family base $10,171 prorated to the primary dwelling: (ADU sq ft / primary sq ft) x $10,171, capped at the published ADU flat rate $3,061. At the 1,600 sq ft default primary, an 800 sq ft ADU pays $3,061 (prorated $5,086, capped). ADUs of 750 sq ft or less are exempt.

fee_items.fee_name: Nipomo CSD water/sewer capacity charges — ADU (not a new residential use)
fee_items.source_note: Nipomo Community Services District Code of Ordinances, Title 2, Chapter 2.04, Section 2.04.100 (Ord. No. 2023-136, sec. 4, 8-23-2023; Municode current version Apr. 3, 2024), read verbatim 2026-11-06: '(B) The district shall not consider an ADU to be a new residential use for the purpose of calculating capacity charges or connection fees for water or sewer service, unless the ADU is detached and built with the construction of a new residential dwelling. (C) For ADUs constructed within the space of an existing home or existing accessory structure, or for new attached ADUs built concurrently with a new single family home, the district shall not require a new or separate sewer connection and shall not impose capacity charges or capacity fees for the new ADU.' No proration by square footage, no under-750 exemption, and no JADU mention in the section. Re-read verbatim live 2026-11-09 from the district's online code book (Municode, version Apr. 3, 2024, current; Supp. 9, codified through Ord. No. 2023-136, passed Aug. 23, 2023): (B) and (C) are unchanged from the 2026-11-06 read. The district's own 2025-26 fee schedule (Res. 2023-1681, re-fetched live 2026-11-09) lists Code Sec. 2.04.100 as 'Capacity Charges, Connection Fees and Monthly Rates for Accessory Dwelling Units (ADUs)'. The $14,821 exception-case figure was re-confirmed live 2026-11-09 in the district's water capacity charges table (Res. 2014-1359: 1 inch or less $4,127 + supplemental water $10,694, effective 7/1/25; ENR May 2025 index 13,839).
fee_items.internal_notes: REPLACES the $14,821 water-capacity figure committed in fb95f36: that is the charge for a NEW 1-inch-or-smaller meter / new residential use (Res. 2014-1359: base $4,127 + supplemental water $10,694, eff. 7/1/25), which 2.04.100(B) says an ADU is not — so it does not apply to an ordinary ADU. EXCEPTION: a detached ADU built with the construction of a new residential dwelling IS treated as a new residential use, and the new-meter capacity charges would then apply (water $14,821 for 1 inch or less; the sewer capacity amount is 'as established by resolution of the board' per 2.04.090 and no such resolution was found — NOT FOUND, do not guess). Monthly sewer service for an ADU is billed at the then-current multi-family rate starting six calendar months after the verification-of-service letter (or occupancy if sooner), with a credit if the County has not certified occupancy (2.04.100(D)) — a recurring service rate, not a one-time fee, so not encoded as a fee item. The $8,675 figure in the June 2023 Civil Grand Jury report ('Build More ADUs', Table 3, repeated in a Marin IJ editorial) is the Jury's own March 17, 2023 estimate for a detached ADU's total NMWD charge: the table's row reads '$7,640/ADU plus' with $8,675.00 for both the 700 and 800 sq ft cases — i.e. the $7,640 FRC plus $1,035 of additional initial charges (outside-agency subtotals $16,292.50 / $20,639.00 confirm the row assignment exactly). fee_items.source_note: Marin Municipal Water District, Code of Ordinances Ch. 11.56, §11.56.050(h) (Ord. 469, 3/18/2025; chapter page fetched live 2026-11-09): a new or separate water service shall not be required and no capacity charges shall be charged for one JADU or one ADU per lot with a proposed or existing single-family dwelling if the JADU meets (h)(1) or the ADU meets (h)(2) or (h)(3). Under (h)(3), a newly constructed attached or detached ADU on a lot with an existing primary residence that has an existing water service pays $0 if: the detached ADU is at most 1,200 sq ft (attached at most 50% of the existing primary dwelling), and (i) the ADU or the existing single-family dwelling is owner-occupied, (ii) both dwellings comply with the water efficiency standards in §13.02.021, and (iii) the applicant has been a continuous district customer at the parcel for at least one year immediately before applying. Does not apply to a JADU or ADU constructed with a new single-family home. Under (h)(4), ADUs that must pay capacity charges pay an amount proportionate to the burden based on drainage fixture unit (DFU) values — no published schedule, amount not encoded.

fee_items.fee_name: Monterey One Water residential sewer capacity charge — per dwelling
fee_items.source_note: Monterey One Water (M1W), 'Residential Capacity Charges' page (montereyonewater.org/191/Residential-Capacity-Charges, read live 2026-11-10): the capacity charge 'is only incurred when connecting a property to the regional sewer system or increasing the number of dwellings on your property' — Fiscal Year 2024-2025: $6,093.55 per dwelling. M1W's 'Capacity (Impact) Fees for Development' fee listing (DocumentCenter doc 127, '3. Fee Listing for Ordinance.xlsx', read live 2026-11-10) agrees: Residential, 'Each living unit', 102/105 gpd, 150 mg/l BOD, strength factor 1.00, EDU factor 1.000 — FY 23-24 $6,056.15, FY 24-25 $6,093.55, change +$37.40. Rate determination: 'adjusted annually every July 1st. The same percent as the annual change in the December Construction Cost Index (CCI) for San Francisco of the prior year based on changes in the Engineering News-Record.' FY 2025-26 FIGURE NOT PUBLISHED: both the page and the fee listing still top out at FY 2024-25 (page crawled 2026-11-09); no FY 2025-26 residential capacity charge was found in any official M1W source (budget, board materials, exact-figure search, 2026-11-10). This row encodes the last published figure ($6,093.55, FY 2024-25); the FY 2025-26 amount is NOT computed from the CCI formula — this site publishes agency figures, not derived amounts. ADU trigger: Monterey County Environmental Health Bureau, 'ADUs on Sewer' (Rev. 8/31/2022, county doc 124198) — before an ADU permit issues, notify the sewer purveyor and obtain an estimate/invoice for the additional sewer service connection; before occupancy/final, furnish evidence the sewer purveyor issued a permit or compliance certificate. The document links M1W's capacity-charges page. A Sewer Connection Permit is also required, and the capacity charge is due at the time of application for the connection permit. SB 1117 (eff. 2027-01-01) does not change this charge: connection/capacity charges are excluded from SB 1117.

fee_items.internal_notes: Method is valuation_table (not valuation_step): Table 1-A applies its per-$1,000 rate to TOTAL valuation, while feeCalc valuation_step computes base + rate x (valuation - threshold)/step (excess basis) — encoding as valuation_step would understate the fee (e.g. $300,000 valuation: code $1,445 vs valuation_step $1,095). Do NOT re-encode as valuation_step without a feeCalc change. No valuation_psf for LA-CITY (LADBS determines valuation; no confirmed $/sq ft ADU basis), so no 800 sq ft total. CF 26-0163 'Suggested Fee' full-cost amounts (e.g. $622.19 + $5.51 per $1,000 for this band) are a Feb 2026 LADBS proposal; PLUM approved Apr 14, 2026 and Budget & Finance moved a phased approach Jun 16, 2026, but no adopting ordinance was found as of Nov 11, 2026 and the current code still shows the 2018 amounts.
fee_items.notes: Table 1-A bands (codified): $0-$100 none; $100.01-$2,000 $65.00; $2,000.01-$20,000 $40.00 + $1.25 per $100 of total valuation; $20,000.01-$50,000 $170.00 + $6.00 per $1,000 of total valuation; $50,000.01-$100,000 $195.00 + $5.50 per $1,000 of total valuation; $100,001-$500,000 $395.00 + $3.50 per $1,000 of total valuation; $500,001-$1,000,000 $520.00 + $3.25 per $1,000 of total valuation; over $1,000,000 $920.00 + $2.85 per $1,000 of total valuation. The per-$1,000 rate applies to TOTAL valuation, not the amount above the band floor. Amounts adjust annually by LA-area CPI each July 1 (§91.107.1.1). LADBS has proposed full-cost fee updates (CF 26-0163, Feb-Jun 2026 reports; ordinance pending as of Nov 2026) — the suggested amounts are NOT current and are not used here. Minimum permit fee: double the §98.0412(a) minimum inspection fee ($90.00 per inspection, Ord. 180,868) = $180.00 for projects requiring more than one inspection (Table 1-A footnote 4); when cumulative fees are below the minimum, the minimum fee is paid and includes the issuing fee.

Verified flip needs a daily-routine area-model decision (e.g. re-scope FI-261 to area 'San Rafael City Schools'). CAP TENSION - UNRESOLVED, DO NOT RESOLVE BY ARITHMETIC: the two published shares sum to $3.77 + $1.67 = $5.44/sq ft, ABOVE the $5.38 SAB Level I cap (SAB increase January 28, 2026). No source states a combined Miller Creek-area total, and $5.44 is NOT a combined rate - do not quote it as one. Possible explanations: Miller Creek's own 2026 study/resolution (not found) may state a different elementary share or a different HSD share for Miller Creek parcels (e.g. $1.61 at 30%); or the SRCS page's $3.77 may pair with a different HS share. Encoding a computed $1.61 HS share or a $5.38 combined total would be an inference - the same prohibition cycle337 applied to the $3.766 elementary inference for Nicasio/Lagunitas/Bolinas-Stinson. 12/1 follow-up: Miller Creek SD's own 2026 study/resolution + FY2025-26 annual developer fee report. VINTAGE CONFLICT (recorded, not encoded): Miller Creek SD's own Developer Fees page (read live 2026-11-11 by the browser task AND independently re-fetched by text - both agree verbatim) still states the 2024 position: combined $5.17/sq ft, Miller Creek $3.62, effective May 11, 2024, based on the March 12, 2024 study. The 2024 combined $5.17 is NOT encoded (stale vintage; would double-count the same fee). The SRCS June 2026 listing ($3.77) is the current published position for the Miller Creek share. LINKED-STUDY MISMATCH (observation): the Miller Creek page's 'Justification Study March 12, 2024' link serves JustificationStudy2022.pdf - the April 12, 2022 study ($4.79 era; Miller Creek $3.35). The March 12, 2024 study text was not retrieved. The 2022 study and the 2021-22 annual report (residential $3.79 combined, 2018) are historical only. ADOPTION (not established): neither 2026 study states a resolution number, adoption date, or effective date (both future-tense 'will levy'). Public hearing notice (downloaded live 2026-11-11, 110,300 bytes, md5 0610020638d1d6ab5b9ee516a837021f): SRCS boards to 'consider approving' April 28, 2026 - SRCS districts only, not Miller Creek (separate board). SRCS page states fees effective June 2026 / increase June 29, 2026. effective_date is therefore null, NOT guessed. ADU: SRCS page requires an application for all ADUs (attached and unattached). Miller Creek page: <500 sq ft exempt, >=500 sq ft charged on the entire addition, application required for all ADUs. The site's feeCalc global SB 543 rule (<500 sq ft school fee $0) governs. Commercial NOT encoded (residential rows only, site convention): Miller Creek commercial $0.61 (SRCS page) / HSD $0.27 (study). RATE VERIFIED from the district's own sources: SRCS Developer Fees page (read live 2026-11-11, independently re-confirmed by direct curl): 'Level One School Impact Fees Effective June 2026' / 'Miller Creek District $3.77' (residential). The $3.77 is the Miller Creek share as listed by SRCS; the SRCS ESD 2026 study (April 14, 2026; downloaded live 2026-11-11, 768,212 bytes, md5 6f698ca823db4bd18c992c9c4a46ae97, 32 pages, read in full) does NOT mention Miller Creek at all - it justifies only the SRCS ESD share, 69.05% = $3.71 residential - so $3.71 must not be used as the Miller Creek share.
fee_items.notes: 800 sq ft x $3.77 = $3,016.00 (Miller Creek School District share only; pairs with San Rafael High School District share MARIN-COUNTY-NEW-25, $1.67. The combined total for Miller Creek-area parcels is NOT stated in any source: $3.77 + $1.67 = $5.44 exceeds the $5.38 SAB Level I cap, so the combined total is unresolved pending Miller Creek's own 2026 study/resolution - see internal notes; do not quote $5.44 as the combined rate).
fee_items.source_note: San Rafael City Schools, Developer Fees page (https://www.srcs.org/9371_3; read live 2026-11-11): 'Level One School Impact Fees Effective June 2026' - Residential: 'Miller Creek District $3.77' (commercial $0.61). Page also states 'Developer Fees increase on June 29, 2026'. The live browser could not open this page (ERR_HTTP2_PROTOCOL_ERROR, all URL variants), so the page text was re-fetched independently and the Miller Creek line confirmed by direct curl. Adoption resolution number and date not retrieved.

fee_items.internal_notes: Flat $0 row: the exemption, not a $0 rate, is the verified fact. The proportional rule for ADUs over 900 sq ft is not encoded as a row because the per-bedroom base depends on the ADU's bedroom count, which the series model does not fix.

FI-243 ($3.83) + NEW-01 ($1.34) = $5.17/sq ft - the 2024-cap vintage sum (PSD FY2024/25 share + AVUHSD 2024-25 adopted share); it is arithmetic across the two shares, not a source-stated combined total, so do not quote it as a published combined rate. feeCalc sums the two shares for the 800 sq ft school total ($4,136).

fee_items.fee_name: Sewerage Facilities Charge (SFC) — new house connection sewer (ADU, per-unit rate)
fee_items.source_note: City of Los Angeles Bureau of Engineering, Sewer / Storm Drain Permits — SFC fee rates table: RESIDENTIAL APT 1 BDRM $454/DU, 2 BDRMS $619/DU; RESIDENTIAL GUEST HOME WITH KITCHEN rated the same as APT. Rate basis LAMC §64.11.3(b): $344.00 per 100 gpd average flow, $159.00 per lb/day BOD, $147.00 per lb/day SS (Ord. 182,076, eff. 6 Apr 2012); generation factors set by the City Engineer per §64.11.3(d).
fee_items.internal_notes: SFC is due only when a NEW house connection sewer (S-Permit) is required (LAMC §64.15; BOE S-Permit manual: SFC and bonded sewer fees, if applicable, must be paid before the S-Permit issues). An ADU that ties into the existing private sewer line triggers no new S-Permit and no SFC. No ADU-specific facility type exists in the BOE SFC rates table — BOE staff select the facility type at S-Permit application. Closest published analogs are the apartment per-unit rates (a guest home with kitchen is rated the same as an apartment): 1 BDRM $454/DU, 2 BDRMS $619/DU. If BOE classifies a detached ADU as a single-family dwelling instead, the SFD rates would apply ($578 1 BDRM, $764 2 BDRMS). Net SFC equals the ADU’s own per-unit rate: the existing home’s SFC is credited in full (BOE credits structures in place before the work). Bonded Sewer Fee ($74 per linear ft of frontage) and Bonded Lateral Fee ($84 per linear ft) apply only where the lot never participated in construction of the sewer mainline — NOT included in this row. Where the sewer is in LA County Sanitation District territory, LACSD connection fees apply instead and the City SFC is 15% of the §64.11.3 rates per §64.11.3(c) — separate row if confirmed. State law: Gov. Code §66311.5(d) — a detached new-construction ADU may be required to install a separate utility connection, and any connection fee or capacity charge must be proportionate to the burden (size or fixtures); ADUs built within existing space cannot be charged at all. Verify facility type with BOE at S-Permit application (city inquiry — separate approval needed).
fee_items.notes: Due only if the ADU needs a new connection to the public sewer main (BOE S-Permit). If the ADU connects through the existing private sewer line, the charge is $0. BOE selects the facility type when you apply — no ADU-specific rate is published. The closest published rates are the apartment per-unit rates ($454 for a 1-bedroom unit, $619 for 2 bedrooms; a guest home with kitchen is rated the same). The existing home’s charge is credited, so the net is the ADU’s own per-unit rate.
